newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian shrs rise on demand for cheap blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Colombian shrs rise on demand for cheap blue chips.

text.p: Colombian stocks rose for the fifth consecutive session as investors snapped up undervalued blue chips, brokers said Thursday.
Bogota's IBB index climbed 1.9 percent to 911.94 in 1.03 billion peso volume, while Medellin's IBOMED general index jumped 2.78 percent to 14,057.54 in 1.06 billion peso trade.

"Foreign funds are taking advantage of attractive prices and are looking for high-performing shares like brewing giant Bavaria, which has performed outrageously lately," one Bogota broker said. On the Bogota exchange, Bavaria leapt 6.6 pesos to 4,800 in volume of 302 million pesos.
